info.text:
Why did Supreme sell for $600M less than it cost?

VF Corp paid $2.1B for Supreme in Dec 2020 and sold it to EssilorLuxottica for $1.5B in Oct 2024: $600M less, about 29% lower.
Supreme's model: in-season Thursday drops in small batches that often sell out and resell for more.
Under VF, Supreme's revenue was $561.5M in fiscal 2022 and $538M in fiscal 2024, and VF wrote down about $735M of its value in fiscal 2023.

Sources: VF Corp 10-K filings (FY2022-FY2024), VF and EssilorLuxottica release (July 2024), Bloomberg, WWD.
News and education, not financial advice.
